clips.title: The story
paras: At Wildmane Water Well, poisoned waters threaten Mulgore’s northern plains and the herds that depend on them.

Across Mulgore, sacred wells sustain the nomadic tauren and their wandering kodo herds. Wildmane Water Well lies at the northern edge of the plains, just beyond Thunder Bluff’s shadow. The Venture Company’s goblins have poisoned its waters to control the regional supply. A tauren-crafted totem is needed for the cleansing ritual that can make the water pure again.
